archived_cold_geometry: Exclude the cold-start G_perf endpoint from this comparison. In the prior source traces its executed action first diverges from S at paid action 44, before this shared paid action 105 state.

event_clock: First exact arrival at the bound target including heading while the initial option is active, or first native abandonment/guard replan of that option at the last actually charged action. Preserve actual route event reasons, executed route actions and metres, later arrival and actual episode terminal independently. For each category-minus-geometry comparison, use max(category event paid, that geometry event paid). area: Use the exact frozen open31 samples and area weights of the published Chain 17 route intervention, with 5 cm Euclidean point-to-triangle distance to the actual fused mesh. One match per evaluable sample. The common fork defines which points were previously recovered. Report gross newly matched area, lost area from that baseline, retained baseline area, net gain, total matched area and target recall. global_and_motion: Record actual first differences in the charged command, base position, full pose, and raw observation. Report actual route-event and terminal actions, route/terminal distance, guards and outcomes, C_free, scene F1 at 5 cm, J=C_free×F1, return and collision counts.
reporting: The main comparison is category minus actual geometric top choice. Keep the equal-cost comparison in the same three-arm table with its actual rank and matching clock. Archive the protocol, native receipt and raw mesh/hash index, table, masks, reproduction commands and publication-ready result paragraph.
